summary: NextEra Energy Inc. filed an 8-K on May 15, 2026, announcing a merger agreement with Dominion Energy Inc. Under the terms, each Dominion share will be converted into 0.8138 NextEra shares plus a pro rata share of $360M cash. No premium or per-share price is explicitly stated. The two-step merger structure involves a first merger into NextEra's subsidiary, followed by a second merger into an LLC. The transaction is expected to close under Virginia law, subject to conditions including regulatory approvals. What to watch: regulatory clearance under antitrust/energy laws and shareholder votes; risk-arb focuses on deal timeline and spread.
